hooks.command: grep -q '\[Example:' PROJECT_BRIEF.md 2>/dev/null && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"UN-ONBOARDED PROJECT — PROJECT_BRIEF.md still contains template placeholders, so this project has not been set up yet. Run the onboarding flow in CLAUDE.md section 12 NOW, before any other work and before answering questions about the code: (1) run npm install to sync the design system, (2) use AskUserQuestion in batches of up to 4 to gather project details, (3) fill in PROJECT_BRIEF.md, propagate the project name, allocate a local port, and rebuild the docs. If the user asked for something else, tell them onboarding comes first and offer to run it — a brief filled in now makes every later task cheaper. This notice disappears once the placeholders are gone."}}' || true

ls handovers 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'HANDOVER.*\.md' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"This project keeps session handovers in handovers/. Read handovers/HANDOVER.md (and any HANDOVER-<topic>.md) BEFORE starting work — it records where the last session left off, what is half-finished, and known traps. Then check PROJECT_PROGRESS.md for history and ROADMAP.md for direction."}}' || true

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Context was just compacted — earlier detail from this session is now summarized and will degrade further on the next compaction. If you are mid-task, follow .claude/commands/handover.md NOW: write or refresh handovers/HANDOVER.md so this work can resume in a fresh session, then continue the task."}}'

jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+commit([[:space:]]|$)' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"A git commit just ran. Keep the tracking documents current (CLAUDE.md section 14): (1) PROJECT_PROGRESS.md — record what this commit shipped under a YYYY-MM-DD heading, newest first, creating today section if absent or extending it if present; (2) ROADMAP.md — delete anything this commit completed or made obsolete, and add any new debt or idea it surfaced. Write what changed and why, not the commit subject verbatim. Skip only for commits a future session would not care about: typo and formatting fixes, and commits that touch nothing but the tracking documents themselves. Do NOT commit these edits on their own — leave them staged or unstaged and fold them into your next commit, otherwise every commit spawns another."}}' || true
